title: Mirroring for Azure Database for MySQL (Preview)

content.text: Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and seamlessly integrate your existing Azure Database for MySQL data with the rest of your data in Fabric. For more information, see Mirroring Azure Database for MySQL.
